notes.title: Holy Human Empire - see the concepts!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings rebel captains![/h1]

As we've mentioned earlier, we are currently focusing on the ship design - coming up with ideas for new vessels, making sketches, concepts and models of vehicles that will be eventually implemented in the game. So we’d like to share with you a few of those!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592390/b1e54cfee6c26a24151c0fff13dffb5b19f2198a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592390/2fcabd4a18b7c2e01c472bd65dcc42bf9b2c811b.jpg[/img]

Behold the fleet of the Holy Human Empire! The HHE, as a faction dominant in the known Galaxy, has a long, militaristic tradition. We try to portray it in the design of the ships, that are efficient, lethal and somewhat rigid. Let us know if you think that we managed to capture it. :)

The images above present two different motherships. Mothership is a center of your formation, your in-game flagship during the ongoing run. However, it’s rather dangerous to fly alone, so at your disposal, there are also different support ships. On the three images belove you can see the support vessel of the HHE. Keep in mind, that they are smaller than the motherships, and your battle formation can consist of a mothership and several support ships. The kinds of vessels and their deployment can (and will) be crucial during the battles!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592390/95d6d95224141efe1cb8421b958317fd02e8d4d0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592390/afbaf17c4ed7b80ca4d23d61b95bc6d787e4b16e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592390/d210e906dbf271c31b4c889f271f97fd47e3bd8e.jpg[/img]

Share your thoughts about the design and (if you still haven’t), add TFF to your wishlist! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/711590/TFF_The_Final_Frontier/

notes.title: Sneak peek into spaceship design
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592390/04908e7e96f5ddc52a8b1dc0edc928fc2444107b.png[/img]

[h1]Greetings brave Rebels![/h1]

First of all, we’d like to assure you, that we're very busy working on [i]The Final Frontier[/i]. One of the important tasks we're facing right now is designing the spaceships that you’ll be able to control while fighting for freedom.

The image above is a sneak peek behind the design of our vessels.

This is one of the motherships (the core vessels in every formation) that we’ve designed. It belongs to the [i]United Kingdom of Atum[/i] (UKA) - one of the in-game factions. UKA combines ancient Egyptian culture with cutting-edge technologies and highly advanced science. Let us know what you think about it!

If you like what you see please add [i]The Final Frontier[/i] to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/711590/The_Final_Frontier/

Stay tuned for more updates!
